messages:
sarah_sales: quick thread — FinBank (prospect) sent an RFP addendum asking about strict EU-only handling during the POC. main asks: no cross-border egress, list of subprocessors for eu regions, BYOK for KMS, and any pricing delta for region-pinned dedicated capacity. timeline they want: 2-week POC

solutions_anna: thanks — can you paste the exact RFP snippet? i want to make sure we don't overpromise. also do they require audit evidence or just an attestation? :thinking_face:

sarah_sales: pasted: "All customer data must remain within EU borders; no data or model state shall transit or be processed outside EU. Customer requires keystore BYOK and subprocessors list for approval." They asked for "evidence" but not specific certs yet.

devops_ian: short answer: we can route and pin tenants to EU regions for the POC, and we can enable KMS BYOK for Private/Dedicated. caveats: some background control plane metadata may touch control plane in us-central unless we run Private. will clarify.

security_liz: critical: we must be explicit about telemetry and control-plane metadata. security teams always flag that. we can provide subprocessors list + attestation for the eu regions. for BYOK we need time for key onboarding (usually 3-5 business days) and an ops runbook.

product_maya: pricing note: Dedicated pinned region adds a sizing/commit impact. for a 2-week POC we can do a temporary pinned pool with a small delta (usually +10–20% on hourly if reserved short-term) — need infra to confirm.

eng_infra_raj: @product_maya quick check: for a short-lived POC we can create a transient tenant pin to eu-west-1 using the routing policy: 
``` 
{ "route_policy": "tenant_pin", "region": "eu-west-1", "fallback": "eu-general" } 
``` This enforces serving in eu-west-1; KV/cache stays local. but control-plane calls (deploy triggers, billing metering) may still hit hosted control plane endpoints unless Private.

solutions_anna: do we have a short list of subprocessors that operate in EU only? customer wants vendor names and contact info for DPA.

security_liz: we have an EU subprocessors appendix. i'll paste the doc link in a follow-up, but quick list: GCP (europe), AWS (eu regions), our telemetry vendor (eu-only tenancy available), logging provider (can be region-locked). will add the versioned attestation PDF.

legal_kate: FYI — if they require guaranteed zero egress under contract we need to route them to Private (on-prem/VPC) or include strict SLAs and indemnities. For POC-level attestation we can do an interim DPA addendum + subprocessors list.

sarah_sales: timeline check: they want POC to start next monday. BYOK 3-5bd means we might miss that. any workaround?

devops_ian: workaround: we can use our ephemeral customer-managed envelope (not full BYOK) where keys are generated per-tenant but managed by Redwood for the POC. security must approve an exception. less ideal but faster.

security_liz: i can approve an exception for POC if they sign a short scoping agreement limiting production data and retention. we require retention <= 7 days and audit log access.

product_maya: ops/infra pricing for ephemeral vs full BYOK: ephemeral — no BYOK onboarding fee; full BYOK — onboarding + 1 engineer support day. estimate numbers and i'll include in POC quote.

eng_infra_raj: also note: subprocessor list updates often. give them a date-bound snapshot (e.g., "subprocessors as of 2026-03-20"). we can provide the RFC-style snapshot PDF.

sarah_sales: perfect. can someone draft a short POC checklist i can send to customer? needs to include: routing policy, key approach (ephemeral vs BYOK), subprocessors snapshot, timeline, and pricing delta.

solutions_anna: i'll draft the checklist and include suggested language for the scoping agreement. will ping legal for the attestation template.

deploy-bot: deploy status: created transient pool eu-west-1 for p12345-poc (not yet active). next step: infra confirm sizing and start window.

eng_infra_raj: i'll confirm sizing + hourly delta by EOD and add the POC pool to the temporary billing bucket.

legal_kate: will prepare a one-page scoping addendum and attach latest subprocessors snapshot (signed).

sarah_sales: awesome — i'll coordinate with the customer and aim for a monday start if we can get the ephemeral key exception approved. thanks everyone :pray:
